Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose‑driven, world‑class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Onze trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – leads in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance‑focused culture.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Processos será responsável por apoiar a implementação dos princípios e ferramentas do HAPS (Haleon Performance System) no site, visando a entrega da Estratégia de Negócios e a melhoria do desempenho nas áreas de Segurança, Qualidade, Serviço e Custo, sempre com uma abordagem orientada por dados.

Além disso, essa função terá papel fundamental no gerenciamento de projetos e na execução de iniciativas de produtividade alinhadas às metas do site. O principal objetivo do cargo é executar os Planos de Melhoria Contínua, contribuindo para o crescimento e a lucratividade da unidade por meio da elevação da performance produtiva e da implementação de projetos de redução de custos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Conhecer e cumprir todas as leis, políticas e diretrizes locais, nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis ao cargo, consultando as áreas responsáveis em caso de dúvidas.
  • Cumprir e garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes do programa ABAC.
  • Assegurar o atendimento às normas básicas de Segurança, Qualidade e Abastecimento, bem como aos sistemas de trabalho aplicáveis.
  • Cumprir o plano de treinamento e desenvolvimento definido para a função.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas da Haleon e normas regulatórias pertinentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Liderar a identificação e implementação de projetos de melhoria de performance e redução de custos, utilizando metodologias e ferramentas como Matriz de Priorização, SWOT e análise de dados de performance.
  • Gerenciar projetos de melhoria contínua, visando aumento de eficiência e redução de desperdícios.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e otimizar ferramentas do HAPS para uso no site.
  • Facilitar eventos Kaizen para impulsionar resultados.
  • Atuar como referência em padrões de melhoria contínua (5S, SMED, AM, Centerlining).
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz (RCA) para perdas recorrentes e crônicas, além de promover o balanceamento e o fluxo de linha.

Por que VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de bens de consumo (FMCG) ou indústria farmacêutica.
  • Domínio do MS Office.
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento em Melhoria Contínua (VSM, TPM, PDCA, Zero Loss Culture).
  • Diferenciais: conhecimento intermediário em Power BI e certificação Lean Six Sigma.
  • Inglês avançado (necessário para interação com times internacionais).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar na nossa fábrica em Jacarepaguá, Rio de Janeiro.

Diversity, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Haleon, vamos além das expectativas e impulsionamos uma cultura em que fazemos o que mais importa. Promovemos um ambiente onde a diversidade seja celebrada, a equidade seja praticada e a inclusão seja vivenciada. Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando a individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta-se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

Care to join us. Find out what life at Haleon is really like

Job Posting End Date

2026‑01‑04

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees. The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

description:
Overview

Laravel Engineer with MySQL Tuning Experience (Remote, LATAM)

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology. We are expanding and seeking a skilled Laravel Engineer who can contribute to fast-paced, high-quality projects and help optimize database performance in large-scale applications.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Laravel-based applications (Laravel 8+), with a focus on scalable architecture.
  • Analyze, optimize, and debug complex SQL queries; optimize performance using EXPLAIN plans, indexing strategies (including composite indexes), and query rewriting techniques.
  • Design and optimize MySQL database schemas for scalability and data integrity in high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Work with Eloquent ORM and Laravel Query Builder; understand how generated SQL impacts performance and optimize accordingly.
  • Build robust, scalable RESTful APIs in Laravel emphasizing performance and data efficiency.
  • Implement robust security practices in backend systems, including Laravel authentication.
  • Participate in testing with Pest PHP and PHPUnit to ensure code quality and reliability.
  • Collaborate with frontend (e.g., ReactJS) when needed and contribute to project planning and estimation.
  • Take ownership of deliverables, align with client goals, and maintain commitments to timelines and quality.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, growth-oriented team environment and stay current with industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience with Laravel (Laravel 8+) and a deep understanding of the framework’s architecture.
  • Expertise in MySQL performance optimization and resolving complex bottlenecks.
  • Strong experience in designing, optimizing, and debugging SQL queries; proficient with indexing, composite indexes, and query rewriting.
  • Proficiency in database schema design and normalization/denormalization for scalable systems.
  • Experience with Eloquent ORM and Laravel Query Builder; understanding of how these tools generate SQL and how to optimize them.
  • Experience with complex, large-scale multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Solid experience with Laravel authentication and backend security practices.
  • Experience with testing tools such as Pest PHP and PHPUnit.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing robust RESTful APIs in Laravel.
  • Experience with ReactJS is a plus.
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to work toward agreed estimates and processes.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to align with client goals.
  • Positive attitude and meticulous attention to detail.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Generous paid time off and flexible working hours.
  • Remote-friendly environment.
  • Continuing education, training, conferences, and company-sponsored coursework and certifications.

description:

HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician

Location: Rio de Janeiro, BR

Contract Type: Permanent

Division: RINA Consulting QOHSE

Level of experience: Intermediate

RINA is currently recruiting for a HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

Mission

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role supports the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures and protocols, for the security of Company assets, projects and business travels. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Compliance Monitoring:
- Ensure that the organization complies with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations.
- Monitor and track changes in regulations and update relevant stakeholders.
Risk Assessment:
- Assist in conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace.
- Collaborate with other departments to analyze and mitigate risks.
Training and Education:
- Support the development and delivery of HSE training programs for employees.
- Help create educational materials to promote awareness of health and safety issues.
Incident Investigation:
- Participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near-misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
- Assist in the documentation of incidents and the implementation of corrective actions.
Data Analysis:
- Collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
- Prepare reports on HSE performance and make recommendations based on the analysis.
Emergency Response Planning:
- Contribute to the development and testing of emergency response plans.
- Assist in organizing drills and training exercises for emergency situations.
Inspections and Audits:
- Support regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with HSE policies and procedures.
- Document findings and work with relevant teams to address any deficiencies.
Communication:
- Assist in the communication of HSE policies and procedures to employees.
- Participate in HSE meetings and collaborate with other departments to promote a culture of safety.
Documentation and Record Keeping:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities.
- Assist in preparing documentation for regulatory agencies and internal audits.
Continuous Improvement:
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures.
- Stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.

Qualifications

  • Technical degree in occupational safety is mandatory, along with registration with the Ministry of Labor and Employment. Bachelor's degree is a plus.
  • Good experience in HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) advisory roles, preferably in industrial or construction sectors.
  • Having certifications related to health and safety can enhance a candidate's profile, including ISO 45001.
  • Familiarity with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations is crucial.
  • Ability to analyze data and identify trends related to health, safety, and environmental performance.
  • Experience in conducting risk assessments , safety audits, and ensuring compliance with local and international standards.
  • Proficient in developing and delivering HSE training and awareness programs.
  • CLIENT INTIMACY – Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations, and requirements to ensure maximum satisfaction
  • EARN TRUST – Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity
  • PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT – Promote commitment by keeping promises as a Role Model
  • MANAGE EMOTIONS – Recognise one's and other's emotions and express and regulate one's reactions
  • PIONEER CHANGE – Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances
  • BUILD NETWORK – Forge trust relationships, across departments, and outside the organization
  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS – Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources and constraint
  • ADDRESS THE WAY – Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret it in a perspective way
  • THINK FORWARD – Capitalise on experiences and translate them into action plans for the future

RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure & mobility, industry, research & development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion.

At RINA, we endeavour to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99.

description:
Descrição

Atuar como especialista em vendas consultivas de soluções de infraestrutura de tecnologia, com foco em ambientes de virtualização, nuvens públicas e tecnologias de datacenter. Este profissional será responsável por identificar e conduzir oportunidades comerciais, propondo e apresentando as soluções TOTVS CLOUD de forma estratégica e personalizada, garantindo aderência às necessidades específicas de cada cliente.

Inserido em um cenário de transformação digital acelerada, o Sales Specialist terá como desafio expandir a presença da TOTVS CLOUD em empresas de diversos segmentos, posicionando nossas soluções em nuvem como catalisadoras de eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e segurança.

Espera-se uma atuação consultiva, com escuta ativa, domínio técnico aplicado e habilidade para construir relações de confiança com decisores técnicos e executivos, conectando os desafios de negócio às capacidades tecnológicas da TOTVS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir apresentações da oferta TOTVS CLOUD, destacando seus diferenciais técnicos e comerciais de forma consultiva e estratégica.
  • Elaborar orçamentos com base nas arquiteturas de referência da oferta, defendendo tecnicamente as propostas junto aos clientes.
  • Confeccionar propostas comerciais completas, incluindo escopo detalhado e precificação alinhada às necessidades do cliente.
  • Desenvolver argumentos de venda e defesas técnicas para sustentar as proposições solicitadas, reforçando valor e competitividade.
  • Construir análises de TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), evidenciando o retorno sobre investimento e payback frente às soluções concorrentes.
  • Participar de reuniões de esclarecimento técnico e comercial, apoiando o time de vendas e os clientes durante o processo de negociação.
  • Controlar pipeline de vendas mensais e de acordo com suas metas definidas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior concluído em áreas relacionadas à Tecnologia da Informação, como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Segurança da Informação, dentre outras afins.
  • Vivência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em soluções de infraestrutura de TI, computação em nuvem, virtualização ou datacenter. Conhecimento técnico sólido em ambientes de nuvem pública (como Azure, AWS, Google Cloud), virtualização de servidores, redes e arquitetura de soluções.
  • Habilidade consultiva para entender os desafios dos clientes e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Capacidade de negociação estratégica, com foco em geração de valor e construção de parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, com desenvoltura para interagir com decisores técnicos e executivos.
  • Certificação em alguma nuvem pública no mínimo no nível intermediário.

#LI-TR1

#LI-ONSITE

Main responsibilities

  • Elaborar, implementar e monitorar soluções de melhoria contínua e de oportunidades de otimização das operações, incluindo processos químicos e práticas de operação de maneira a manter a produção dos ativos de forma segura e contínua;

  • Elaborar e verificar Procedimentos, Work Packs de atividades ou projetos do time de engenharia;

  • Realizar análises de engenharia em falhas de equipamentos/sistemas ou mau-funcionamento e conduzir análises da causa raiz, propondo melhorias para o aumento de performance e vida útil dos equipamentos;
  • Verificar performance de equipamentos (estáticos e rotativos);
  • Participar das reuniões diárias de operações e reuniões para revisão do plano de atividades integradas bem como reuniões de projetos;
  • Manter interface continua com os times: de manutenção, assegurando o funcionamento e desempenho de equipamentos críticos; de engenharia de produção, avaliando possíveis causas para baixas de produção e encontrando soluções para otimização; e times de bordo (offshore), dando todo suporte necessário referente à processos;
  • Suportar e garantir continuidade operacional do processo topside para atender novos projetos/interligações PRIO;
  • Elaborar e verificar divulgação de relatórios de Lições Aprendidas e Awareness.

Requirements and skills

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico);

  • Formação Superior em Engenharia: Química, Mecânica ou Petróleo

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • PI
  • Simuladores de Processos (HYSYS)
  • Experiência com FPSOs

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Control & Automation Engineer
description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Automation Engineer is responsible for working with our customers to design solutions to control, monitor and automate their industrial processes. On this level it is expected to demonstrate the ability to manage customer expectations and product quality from tendering through life of the field. This includes design and configuration of control systems of varying complexity and coaching peers in good design and better practices. The candidate must demonstrate process and project management skills to function effectively with customers, peers and the product development team.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, unit test and deliver high quality, performant software applications.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Coordinate with QA team to develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development technologies, tools, and processes.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher within Electronic, Controls & Automation, Mechatronics, Chemical, Electrical, Computer Science or equivalent Engineering, with focus on industrial process control.
  • Active CREA
  • Advanced English
  • Experience in developing automated applications or research that involved process automation
  • Experience within configuration and design of industrial control systems on the hardware, software or modelling side.
  • Design, review and implement both the software and hardware components of a control system from instrumentation to the operator HMI.
  • Understand dynamics within linear and non-linear systems in general, but upstream oil and gas processes in special.
  • Release project documentation, according to International Standards and Customer requirements and present them for customer approval.
  • Understand pros and cons of industrial protocols, such as Modbus, Profibus, serial, etc. and how they are used.
  • Advanced experience with multiple text and visual programming languages
  • Experience with Python programming is highly desirable

Senior/Staff Data Engineer (Fintech team) (Bangkok based, relocation provided)

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation‑inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom‑line impact.

About BCG Platinion

BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time‑sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions.

Practice Area

BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York‑based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh‑based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.

What You'll Do

You will be part of BCG Platinion and collaborate with our colleagues from BCG Strategy Consulting, Digital Ventures and Gamma to work on UK and international client projects. You will assess and coach our clients' IT teams, define IT strategies and architecture solutions, establish and manage delivery teams and roll up your sleeves to build proof of concepts and MVPs, applying your technical know‑how, your understanding of business contexts and your analytical and conceptual skills.

Responsibilities

  • Manage work packages/modules in critical IT implementation projects
  • Perform technical architecture, code reviews & performance of technical proofs of concept
  • Analyze complex IT application landscapes, optimize development processes and Solution Architecture
  • Develop functional and technical online and Internet strategies
  • Conduct IT project management and quality assurance

Our Expert Consulting Track

The Expert Consulting Track (ECT) is vital to BCG’s ability to successfully meet our clients’ demand for deep expertise and advanced technical capabilities. Experts deliver next‑level impact for BCG's most complex and cutting‑edge client challenges. Experts focus on developing BCG's thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team to bring the ‘best of BCG’ to our clients, Experts come from diverse backgrounds, with expertise often gained outside of BCG in industry, academia, or specialized consulting.

What You'll Bring

  • Between 6‑10 years' experience in software development, technical project management, digital delivery or technology consulting
  • Full understanding of interdependencies between own work stream and overall project context, being able to scope and design a work stream autonomously and take responsibility for it
  • Can run a workshop at peer level: effectively facilitating client meetings, preparing CTMs, co‑leading a content topic as well as coaching other project members and able to generate trust, to be perceived by the client as a potential partner
  • A university degree with above‑average academic performance in a STEM related field
  • Extensive technical expertise (overarching understanding of architecture, object‑oriented programming languages, database design and systems, component technologies, XML standards, and current technology trends) of digital solutions on mobile devices as well as legacy environments
  • Extensive experience in the assessment of IT target architectures in an enterprise environment, component technologies, and service‑oriented architectures
  • Experience with No‑SQL and SQL DBs, also exposure to big data environments (e.g., Hadoop, Redshift)
  • Technical experience with Cloud services and infrastructure

Who You'll Work With

  • BCG Managing Directors and Partners (MDPs)
  • PLA Managing Directors (MDs)
  • BCG Consultants at all levels
  • PLA Consultants at all levels
  • Clients, vendors, and partners

title: Voice and Services Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As a Network Engineering member in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. You will prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio, define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area, and participate and support the other functional areas in cross‑functional projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end‑to‑end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of end‑to‑end system testing requirements
  • Follow‑up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross‑team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I‑CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces – Gm Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency is mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle and Ribbon IMS products

Benefits

  • CLT contract – enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses – to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave – 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance – provided to mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities : Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure : Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team : From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment : Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development : Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience : Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture : Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude : Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections, and the escalation of risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the ongoing development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On‑going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast‑related overlay, as well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on‑site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office. Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play‑off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high‑pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high‑quality service delivery.

description:
Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented. We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities. Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFiExperience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

1GLOBAL is an equal‑opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

  • Experience with Aurora PostgreSQL, Redshift, SQL Server on EC2, EventBridge, IAM, API Gateway, Amplify, Step Functions, Glue

Nice to Have

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Disclosures

description:
MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA E-MULTI - AP 4.0 – SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião‑dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria com RQE;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021 , a saber:
  • RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.
    • Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).
    • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
    • Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.
    • Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB).
    • Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

Requisitos e qualificações

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Esse papo também abordará a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e esclarecer dúvidas. Dicas: queremos saber sobre experiências alinhadas aos valores da PRIO, apresentando contextos, responsabilidades, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado. Em seguida, aspectos mais técnicos podem envolver um case ou entrevista com o gestor da vaga para conhecer os desafios técnicos e serem avaliados dentro dos requisitos. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da área para a escolha final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Atualize-se sobre notícias recentes da empresa, seja pela imprensa ou pelo site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO;
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre insucessos. Desejamos um bom processo seletivo. Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

(2025) BR - R&I - Gerente de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva - L'Oréal Pesquisa & Inovação

A L'Oréal nasceu da ciência, criada pelas mãos e visão de um químico. Desde então, a ciência permaneceu no coração da nossa missão como empresa. O nosso principal objetivo é: inovar para promover o melhor da ciência e criar experiências de beleza inigualáveis para nossas marcas e consumidores. Nosso mindset é orientado para trabalhar com uma inovação aberta e colaborativa. Fazer parte dos nossos times de ciência e tecnologia significa constuir um mundo onde a humanidade e a natureza prosperam juntos. Então venha com a gente expandir os limites da Ciência e da Tecnologia.

Você é apaixonado pelos diferentes sentidos, e curioso pela ciência por trás de um produto e seu impacto nos sentidos e emoções humanas? Você é um líder inspirador, que tem a habilidade de liderar mudanças e desenvolver talentos na área de ciência sensorial e cognitiva? Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, esta é a posição que vai brilhar seus olhos e despertar suas sensações e emoções!

Estamos buscando uma liderança inovadora que tem visão de longo prazo e paixão por ciência sensorial para levar o time de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva (Evaluation Intelligence) a outro nível. A posição de Gerente de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva na América Latina na L’Oréal é responsável por liderar um time inovador e orientado por resultados com forte conhecimento em análise sensorial, que contribui para todas as categorias em Latam (Hair care, Color e Skin care).

Essa posição vai liderar o time de forma estratégica, ajudando no desenvolvimento de produtos com visão holística de performance e experiência do consumidor pela caracterização sensorial e entendimento de comportamentos e emoções. Essa posição reportará diretamente para a Head de Evaluation Intelligence Latam e será parte do seu Mancom/time de liderança.

Principais Atividades

  • Liderar e implementar o Roadmap e Objetivos da Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva para a organização
  • Liderar um grupo de analistas, técnicos e coordenadores (13+) e ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento do time em Ciência Sensorial & Cognitiva, Data, Digital & Tech
  • Liderar a compreensão sensorial aprofundada de nossos principais produtos, concorrentes e inovações atuais
  • Liderar com a equipe a comunicação dos principais e mais estratégicos resultados sensoriais/cognitivos de projetos para orientar a decisão de negócios
  • Construir uma organização efetiva e com recrutamento e retenção de pessoas chave para o time, promovendo o trabalho colaborativo e uma cultura diversa e inclusiva
  • Liderar esforços para promover diversidade e inclusão em todas as metodologias e estudos, garantindo que atendamos às necessidades de todos os consumidores em sua imensa diversidade
  • Ser responsável pela melhor avaliação sensorial & cognitiva da categoria, para responder a perguntas de desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecendo resultados que ajudarão a aprimorar conceitos, tecnologias e fórmulas
  • Permanecer atualizado sobre questões específicas da indústria e novas técnicas de avaliação sensorial/cognitiva e manter relacionamentos externos para identificar potenciais colaboradores para a exploração de novas metodologias
  • Implementar e desenvolver estratégias para atividades de publicação científica, transformação de aprendizados em melhores práticas internas e entrega desses aprendizados à rede global da L'Oréal
  • Ser pioneiro em novas tecnologias de aprimoramento sensorial para entender melhor o consumidor e a percepção/desempenho de produtos, utilizando ferramentas como realidade aumentada/virtual, ciência comportamental, IA e interação humano-computador, etc.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os parceiros da L'Oréal para construir relacionamentos de alta qualidade com as partes interessadas para garantir objetivos claros do projeto, alinhamento, crescimento e entrega de valor como uma equipe integrada
  • Liderar colaborações locais e globais dentro de Evaluation Intelligence, L'Oréal R&I Hubs e parceiros externos para desenvolver e implementar as melhores práticas de painel sensorial, novas formas de trabalho e metodologias sensoriais/cognitivas

Requisitos

  • Mestrado/PhD em Ciência de Alimentos, Engenharia, Química, Ciências Sociais, Psicologia ou áreas afins com mais de 10 anos de pesquisa sensorial/cognitiva, de consumo e de produtos em uma função estratégica
  • Ter experiência em liderar pessoas, com sucesso demonstrado no desenvolvimento e construção de uma equipe de alto desempenhoExperiência de trabalho em um ambiente multicultural internacional e capacidade de pensar globalmente
  • Forte habilidade com pessoas, trabalho colaborativo e formação de equipes multidisciplinares, além de habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação (escrita/oral) e com diplomacia e poder de influência
  • Capacidade de fornecer insights claros por meio da análise de conjuntos de dados múltiplos/complexos com experiência em análise sensorial/cognitiva, experiência do usuário, Design thinking e comunicação visual
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de desenvolvimento de inovação, sensorial e insights do consumidor
  • Conhecimento e paixão por beleza, cosméticos, dispositivos e tecnologia digital são a vantagem
  • Deve ser proficiente em Outlook, Word, PowerPoint e Excel

Habilidades

  • Orientado para as pessoas, acessível e empático(a)
  • Pessoa curiosa e visionária
  • Impulsionador(a) por ideias disruptivas e inovadoras
  • Flexível, ágil, proativo(a) e pragmático(a)
  • Detalhista e organizado(a)

The Regional Sales Leader – LATAM is responsible for driving strategic sales initiatives to boost top-line performance across the region.   6. Collaborate with Revenue Management to align sales strategies with forecasting and business priorities.

  10. Guide the Sales team through leadership, mentoring, and regular feedback. Create tailored development plans to support team growth.
  11. Ensure alignment and consistent implementation of global sales strategies throughout the LATAM region.
  12. Maintain full knowledge of all locations, services, packages, and promotions offered by the properties.
  13. Adapt priorities as directed by the VP of Sales, VP of Operations, or evolving business needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

  1. Minimum of 8 years of experience in sales within the hospitality industry, preferably in regional or multi-property roles.
  2. Proven experience managing sales strategies across multiple countries in LATAM.
  3. Advanced proficiency in English and local language (Spanish and/or Portuguese, depending on location).
  4. Strong leadership capabilities with a proven ability to lead and inspire high-performing teams.
  5. Excellent analytical and communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
  6. Passionate about challenges, results-driven, and strategically focused.
  7. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other tools for data analysis and professional presentations.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary: A compensation package that reflects your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the role.
  • Job Stability: Join a dynamic and growing company that values long-term success and career progression.

At Collective Hospitality/ Socialtel , we believe in rewarding talent and fostering a supportive work environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO que seja organizado, prestativo e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;
  • Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;
  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • -Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • -Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • -Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • -Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • -Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • -Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!
